model_card.target: Probability that the building's next Initial FISP façade filing records an UNSAFE condition (a licensed inspector's recorded result, not structural-collapse risk).
model_card.score_definition: Calibrated probability (Platt scaling) from gradient-boosted trees on façade filing history, DOB and ECB violations and building attributes, using only records available before the decision date.

metrics.label: Cycle-9 test PR-AUC (model vs last-status rule)
Precision in top 500 (model vs rule; base rate)
Previously-SAFE buildings: precision in top 250 (base rate)

limitations: Ranks buildings for proactive inspection; it does not certify safety or predict collapse.
Only buildings that file have outcomes; never-filers are missing not at random.
PLUTO building attributes are a 2026 snapshot (age/floors/lot are near-static).
Satellite ground motion was tested and did not improve the model; it is shown as a separate layer.

rank_scope: rank is within this map area; prediction.citywide_rank is across all pending FISP buildings

meta.label: Probability that the building's next Initial FISP filing (cycle 10) records an UNSAFE façade
meta.tiers: rank percentile among pending buildings: high ≤5%, elevated ≤20%, typical ≤60%, low otherwise
caveats: Recorded inspection outcome, not structural-collapse risk.
Label exists only for buildings that file; never-filers are missing not at random.
Locations are PLUTO lot centroids (shared by buildings on one lot).
